notes.title: Update 1: Endless Mode
notes.content:
Endless Mode for all areas has been added, which can be unlocked by completing Standard Mode.

[h3]How Endless Mode Works[/h3]

[list]
[*] Only one artifact spawns at a time, at a random part of the level. These artifacts emit a resonating sound when they appear, and occasionally thereafter. Listen where the sound is coming from to find the artifact.

[*] Similar to Standard Mode, the Ringing of Twilight gets faster over time. But here, it can be slowed down by collecting artifacts. The amount this affect the Ringing of Twilight decreases with each artifact collected.

[*]  [b]In order to finalize your score, you must return back to the Entry Warp, getting a game over means your score is lost.[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Artifacts can now be collected in Serenity Mode.
[*] After collecting an artifact, the Ringing of Twilight will now prefer reappearing towards the center of the level, relative to the player
[*] Added Screen Shake slider in settings. This controls how intense the shaking effect is when the Ringing of Twilight is close.
[*] Added Field of View slider
[*] The lighting and trajectory of the golden spiral effect in Celestial Catacombs has been altered
[*] The trajectory of the crimson stars effect in Celestial Catacombs has been altered
[*] The shallow lake portion of Purity Pocket has been slightly altered
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1 (March 14 2025)
notes.content:
- Small optimizations have been made to each level

- On the main menu's [i]title screen[/i], holding down "H", "E", "L" and "P" keys for 5 seconds now unlocks all levels and modes.
